seed_data.title: The Serum
seed_data.description:
イエベ肌・ブルベ肌を魅せる導入美容液。

肌本来の輝きを引き出し、肌タイプを活かした「透明感 ※1 」を手にいれる

パーソナルカラー診断でイエローベース・ブルーベースを決める要素のひとつ「肌質」の違いに着目。多くの方が理想とする、くすみのない ※２ ・透明感 ※1 あふれる美肌のあり方や、必要なアプローチの違いを研究。それぞれの肌が持つユニークな個性を最大限に際立たせ、内側から輝くような美しさを引き出す導入美容液。
本来の肌の魅力を覚醒させ、自信に満ちた輝きへ。

The Serum γ (イエベの方へ) 
自然由来指数 ※3 ：99.54% 

肌に黄みを感じる、イエローベースの方向け。活力ある雰囲気が魅力。
肌のごわつきに働きかけ肌のキメを整えることで、やわらかくしなやかな肌へと導き、明るく輝く肌印象へ。
PCA-Na ※4 ・フルーツ酸 ※5 配合

The Serum β (ブルベの方へ) 
自然由来指数 ※3 ：98.89% 

肌に青みを感じる、ブルーベースの方向け。涼しげな雰囲気が魅力。
潤いで満たして乾燥から守り、ハリ感のある肌に。顔全体をすっきりと澄み渡らせ、透明感 ※1 や洗練感を演出。
ビタミンP ※6 ・カフェイン ※4 配合

※１ 潤いによる肌印象
※２ 乾燥よる肌のくすみ
※３ 自然由来指数は水を含む数値。ISO16128国際標準の規定に基づき、商品中の全配合成分に占める自然由来成分の比率 
※４ 保湿成分
※５ ライム果汁、オレンジ果汁、グレープフルーツ果実エキス、サンザシエキス、ナツメ果実エキス、リンゴ果実エキス（整肌成分）

seed_data.title: Silk Night Cream
seed_data.description:
50ml 

The Silk Night Cream is a rich, restorative treatment designed to deeply hydrate, firm, and reinforce the skin’s barrier overnight. Enriched with the proprietary Hydrolysed Silk Complex HSC01-A™ , squalene, and vitamin E, the cream delivers intense moisture while supporting elasticity and cell renewal.

Its velvety texture melts into the skin, creating a soft, breathable veil that leaves the complexion visibly firmer and more radiant by morning.

BENEFITS 
Immediately: Skin feels nourished, soothed, and comforted. With continued use: Skin appears firmer, more elastic, and visibly revitalised.

Dermatologically tested and approved. Patch test before application.
Approved under the Leaping Bunny programme.

seed_data.title: Gentle Silk Cleanser
seed_data.description:
100ml 

The Gentle Silk Cleanser is a daily cleansing formula enriched with the proprietary Hydrolysed Silk Complex HSC01-A™ and glycerin to purify the skin while preserving its essential lipids. Designed to respect the skin’s natural barrier, it removes impurities, environmental residue, and excess oil without disturbing the skin’s optimum hydration equilibrium.

Its lightweight, feather-soft texture transforms on contact with water, emulsifying into a milky fluid that rinses away effortlessly. The result is a complexion that feels clean, comfortable, and prepared for exfoliation.

BENEFITS
Immediately: Skin is refreshed, softened, and hydrated. With continued use: Skin appears smoother, more balanced, and visibly more radiant.

Dermatologically tested and approved. Patch test before application.
Approved under the Leaping Bunny programme.

seed_data.title: Radiance Elixir
seed_data.description:
An Ultra-Concentrated Nutrient Infusion for Ageless Radiance 

100% Natural Origin 

AFRAKARI’s most premium botanical elixir - a concentrated, waterless oil serum formulated to deliver visible radiance, refined texture, and lasting skin resilience. Created for skin exposed to urban stress, fatigue, and dehydration, this fast-absorbing elixir combines rare African and nutrient-dense seed oils to brighten, nourish, and strengthen without heaviness. 

Powered by South African Prickly Pear Seed Oil, Rosehip Oil, Marula Oil, Manketti Oil, Ximenia, Kalahari Melon, Pomegranate, and Red Raspberry Seed Oils, Radiance Elixir is designed to leave the skin luminous, smooth, and supple while maintaining a weightless finish suited to humid climates. 

This is a multi-benefit botanical elixir for healthy-looking, refined, glow-rich skin through a high-performance, minimalist formula.
